entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: All right, we made it![n]Wait, where's Mika?

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: Oh, so you came for my special.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You asked for me, right?[n]Wow... I barely recognize you.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Did you lose weight?[n]Or maybe change your makeup?

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: The theme for today's shoot[n]is "the elegance of woman."

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: So, I conditioned my[n]body to be more elegant.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wh-What do you mean?

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: Controlling what you eat, how you[n]move... That's all. It may sound[n]easy, but it's pretty tough.

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: You have to write down everything you[n]eat, making sure to check the nutritional[n]and caloric content.

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: I even hired a personal trainer[n]to take special note of my diet[n]and oversee my exercise regimen.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Whoa... That's amazing! Does[n]that mean you don't get to eat[n]double chocolate crêpes?

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: Of course I don't! I'd get fat[n]with just one bite of that stuff!

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: Not to mention the other stuff I do![n]I take herbal medication, wear[n]warming socks, do pilates and yoga...

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: Day after day... How many squats[n]do you think I do in a week!?

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: Ugh, a natural beauty like you[n]could never understand how much[n]work I put into my modeling!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You know, it's kinda embarrassing[n]getting complimented like that...

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: Sorry, did I say natural beauty?[n]What I meant was natural airhead.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Who are you calling an airhead!?

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: Eeek! Ann-senpai, stop iiit![n]You're scaring meee!

entries.speaker: Cameraman
entries.en: Mika-chan! Are you okay?

entries.speaker: Magazine Staff
entries.en: Man, cat fights are scary...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Grrrr...

entries.speaker: Cameraman
entries.en: This way, Mika-chan. Yeah,[n]that's perfect. That's exactly[n]the expression I'm looking for.

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: *giggle*

entries.speaker: Cameraman
entries.en: Wonderful, wonderful!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I see now... This is a test...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well, I'm not gonna lose...!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Teehee! [clr 2][f 1 9 0][clr 27]

entries.speaker: Cameraman
entries.en: Um, Ann-chan... could you try[n]being a little... sexier?

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: You mean like this?

entries.speaker: Cameraman
entries.en: Oooh, that's beautiful!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: M-Mika!? Why are you doing this?[n]I thought you looked up to me!

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: You should have known that[n]was a lie... but I guess you're[n]just as naïve as you look.

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: Anyway, stupid amateurs like[n]you really piss me off. You[n]better not drag me down, okay?

entries.speaker: Cameraman
entries.en: Oh, you're amazing, Mika-chan!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Grrr...!

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: Oooh, you know the president[n]of that fancy car company?

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: Introduce me, pleeease? [clr 2][f 1 9 0][clr 27]

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: Mm-hm, mm-hm! The owner even[n]invited me to dinner!

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: Y'know, working with all of you[n]just makes me so... happy! [clr 2][f 1 9 0][clr 27]

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Um...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm heading home...
